pick.name: Starlight (Astro)
pick.what: Astro's docs theme: search, i18n, MDX
pick.why: Same framework as the marketing site (one stack, one free Cloudflare deploy), MIT, and Claude Code handles it well

alts.name: Mintlify (Starter)
alts.what: Hosted docs platform with API playground
alts.why: Zero-maintenance hosted docs; free includes custom domain, 5 editors and an MCP server; Pro jumps to USD 450/mo
alts.free_limits: Starter free: custom domain, 5 editors, MCP server; no AI assistant

alts.name: Fumadocs
alts.what: React docs framework (Next.js, TanStack Start, React Router)
alts.why: Best when docs live inside a Next.js app; OpenAPI playground, llms.txt

candidates.name: Mintlify Starter
candidates.verdict: Pick for hosted, API-heavy docs with zero upkeep

candidates.name: Fumadocs
candidates.verdict: Pick for docs inside a Next.js app

candidates.name: GitBook
candidates.verdict: Free has no custom domain; Essential USD 65/site/mo

candidates.name: Docusaurus / Nextra
candidates.verdict: Fine, but no edge over the three above

decision: Starlight keeps docs and marketing site in one Astro codebase on one free host. Switch to Mintlify if API reference + hosted MCP for docs matters more than control, or to Fumadocs if docs must sit inside the Next.js app.
details: Starlight pages were not fetched; version/licence are from the npm registry.

verify.note: @astrojs/starlight 0.42.7 (2026-10-23, MIT) confirmed. Mintlify Starter confirmed: free with custom domain, 5 editors, MCP server, no AI; Pro USD 450/mo annual.
